retrieved_sources.title: Digital Banking, Security and Grievance Redressal Policy
retrieved_sources.passage:
Customers must report an unauthorised transaction as soon as they notice it, through the app, net banking, or by calling the 24x7 helpline 1800-120-4567.
| When reported | Customer liability |
|---|---|
| Within 3 working days of receiving the alert | Zero liability for third-party frauds |

evaluations.observed_output:

- After 7 working days, liability follows the bank’s board‑approved policy [1].  
- The bank will credit the disputed amount to your account within 10 working days of the report, while the investigation continues [1].

Interest rates on domestic fixed deposits below ₹3 crore, effective from 1 April 2026:
| Tenor | General public (p.a.) | Senior citizens (p.a.) |
|---|---|---|
| 7 to 45 days | 3.50% | 4.00% |
| 46 to 90 days | 4.75% | 5.25% |
| 91 to 180 days | 5.50% | 6.00% |
| 181 to 364 days | 6.40% | 6.90% |
| 1 year to less than 2 years | 7.00% | 7.50% |
| 2 years to less than 3 years | 7.10% | 7.60% |
| 3 years to less than 5 years | 7.00% | 7.50% |
| 5 years to 10 years | 6.90% | 7.40% |
Senior citizens (60 years and above) receive an additional 0.50% per annum over the general rate.

retrieved_sources.title: Fixed Deposit and Recurring Deposit Policy
retrieved_sources.passage: The Tax Saver FD has a fixed tenor of 5 years with a lock-in period of 5 years. Deposits up to ₹1,50,000 in a financial year qualify for deduction under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act, as per prevailing tax law. The interest rate is 6.90% per annum for all customers. Premature withdrawal and loans against this deposit are not allowed.

retrieved_sources.title: Fixed Deposit and Recurring Deposit Policy
retrieved_sources.passage: A loan or overdraft up to 90% of the deposit value can be taken against a fixed deposit at an interest rate 1.00% above the FD rate, without breaking the deposit.
